name: Michaels (Make Market)
summary: Make Market is Michaels' general craft house brand, extended in 2026 into a PLA-only filament line (Basic, Matte, Silk, Glitter, White Marble, plus a 4-count multicolor pack) on 2.2 lb / 1 kg spools sold in ~1,300 US/Canada stores, michaels.com and delivery-partner mirrors. No TDS, temps or manufacturer disclosure of any kind; the contract extruder is unknown.

oem_relationships.notes: Michaels is a craft retailer, not an extruder; no packaging, country-of-origin or OEM disclosure recoverable (michaels.com blocks automated reading; data reconstructed from search-indexed SKU slugs and Shipt/Instacart/Uber Eats catalog mirrors).
